The '''GI/80.b Overthruster ion engine''' was a type of [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drive]] manufactured by [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Ghtroc Industries]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Two of these [[Engine/Legends|engines]] were mounted on each [[720 light freighter/Legends|Class 720 freighter]].<ref name="ETU" />
